title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Regulations References) Bill 2018
short_title: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Regulations References) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would update Australia's offshore petroleum and gas storage law so that references to regulations stay valid when those regulations expire and are remade.
It would remove specific regulation titles from the Act and let future regulations instead prescribe which regulation titles or provisions apply.
The change covers provisions related to monitoring, investigation and polluter pays obligations under the Regulatory Powers (Standard Provisions) Act 2014.
changes: Remove fixed references to regulation titles from the OPGGS Act.
Allow regulation titles or provisions to be set by future regulations under the same Act.
Prevent the Act from needing amendment each time regulations sunset and are remade.
summary.affected: Entities subject to monitoring, investigation and financial assurance obligations under the offshore petroleum and greenhouse gas storage regime.

speeches.speaker: Darren Chester
speeches.brief: The Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Regulations References) Bill makes technical amendments to future-proof references to regulations in the act, allowing titles to be prescribed by regulation so the act does not need amending each time regulations sunset and are remade.

speeches.speaker: Darren Chester
speeches.brief: The Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage (Regulatory Levies) Amendment (Regulations References) Bill 2018 makes technical amendments to future-proof references to regulations in the levies act, mirroring changes to the OPGGS Act and ensuring cost-recovery levies for the National Offshore Petroleum Safety and Environmental Management Authority.
